entities.name: Network initiated detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to detach a UE from the network.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of detach (e.g., re-attach required or not).

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is not registered with the network.

relations.description: Network initiated detach procedure includes sending DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type information element.
Network initiated detach procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
Successful completion of network initiated detach procedure establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
